paper_anchor: Proposition 3.1; Equations (6), (9), and Appendix F.1 Equations (109)-(118)
statement: For mu_l and nu in P_ac,2(R^d), the full VWGF objective (6) equals the full S-JKO objective (9), after the critic sign change.
assumptions: mu_l and nu are absolutely continuous probability measures with finite second moments
f is a proper convex divergence generator and f-star is convex
the coupling minimax theorem used in Appendix F.1 applies
the optimal coupling is recoverable by a Monge map because the source is absolutely continuous

quantifiers.measures: every mu_l, nu satisfying the assumptions
quantifiers.objectives: the unrestricted mathematical objectives, not finite neural parameterizations
